title: The Border
openLocation: Southeastern Eversong Woods, on Farstrider patrol near the Amani frontier.
transport: Thalassian horses for Sylvanas, Lor'themar, and the mounted patrol.
immediateObjective: Finish the troll sweep, dodge the Convocation budget session, and stay outdoors one more day.

Jaina is only 'the mage', 'the human', or 'the prisoner' in Sylvanas's head until Cyndia names her in Beat 7
No Jaina dialogue anywhere in this chapter
No trust or warmth between Sylvanas and Jaina
No plague, no leyline-corruption explanation, no proof beyond one stone humming wrong
Silvermoon is not shown directly; Convocation exists only as Sylvanas's avoidance

povKnowsAtOpen: Routine Amani pressure on the southeastern frontier
Ward network looks stable in every formal report
Farstriders keep files on powerful human mages near the border
Jaina Proudmoore is one of the names worth watching

Jaina is in Farstrider custody and must make her case to Sylvanas

The breach is a serious interrogation, not a patrol annoyance

pov: She opens treating anything south of the wards as someone else's problem unless it touches her stones, roads, or riders.
She wants to finish the troll work, stay on her horse, and avoid the Convocation budget session.
A ward-stone hums wrong under her own palm. Then a runner reports a human mage inside the wards who says the leylines are wrong, and an easy patrol day becomes her problem.
By the end, the border mess belongs to her, and the prisoner is waiting in her own holding space.

beats: Before Sylvanas sees her, Jaina is just the human mage who ruined an easy day.
Sylvanas expects a polished Kirin Tor problem: spy, diplomat, or both.
What she finds instead is a road-worn young mage who looks exhausted, furious, and very far from court.
Even then, Jaina is still only the mage, the human, or the prisoner inside Sylvanas's head.

team.label: Partnership
beats: There is no partnership here. One woman is in custody, and the other decides how hard the door stays shut.
Jaina shifts from paperwork headache to the one person Sylvanas has to hear out.
The chapter ends on their first hard face-to-face with no warmth and no softening.

castAndHandoffRules: Lor'themar Theron: present in Scene 1; exits north in Scene 1 to brief the Convocation.

Ranger Cyndia: enters in Scene 2 as border-post officer; remains active into Chapter 2.
Jaina Proudmoore: seen in Scene 2, does not speak on-page.
Next chapter opens at Cyndia's post on the interrogation beat; Lor'themar and patrol already northbound.

scenes.title: The Hunt
scenes.sceneFunction: Show Sylvanas in her element, have a ward-stone read wrong in her own hand, and bring the runner whose news confirms it.
scenes.knowledgeAtSceneStart: Routine frontier work. Trolls are the only threat on the board. Sylvanas expects a slow day outdoors and dreads the budget session.
scenes.arcPressure: Test of her border-only frame: the stone and the runner make the south hers.
scenes.enrichment: Eversong's runestones are Highborne-built wards against Amani raids that also dampen non-elven magic (warcraft.wiki.gg/wiki/Eversong; wowpedia Eversong Woods); post-Second War Amani were hunted across Eversong, and Zul'jan lingered on the border (warcraft.wiki.gg/wiki/Lightwood). Horse notes from thalassian-horses.md: sidestep then calm at ward vibration. Thalassian Pass as the troll-side border route was NOT confirmed by search; this follows the project's locations file.

beats.goal: Finish the troll sweep and take the last Amani axethrower as he breaks cover.
beats.conflict: Last raider bolts through thick ferns; she must judge footing, range and opening in a breath.

outcome.summary: Clean kill; the sweep is done and the patrol gets a breather.

newOnPageInformation: The sweep is finished and the patrol is clean
Sylvanas is most herself in the field, reading ground effortlessly
stillUnknownAfterBeat: Anything worse than trolls on the border
sensoryAnchors: troll blood in sweet Eversong air
beats.transitionIntent: sensory-carry: the quiet after the kill is the room she uses to stall

beats.goal: Stretch the patrol south on the pretext of checking ward-stones, then check the nearest stone herself, bare palm on the rune face.
beats.conflict: Lor'themar sees through the stall; the stone hums out of step with cold under the warmth, and she has no magister's vocabulary for it.

outcome.summary: She confirms something is off with the stone but cannot name it; Lor'themar files it under magister work and she rides on.

newOnPageInformation: A healthy stone hums warm and even; this one hums out of step with cold deep inside
Every formal report calls the network stable
Lor'themar dismisses it as work for the magisters
stillUnknownAfterBeat: What is wrong with the stone
Whether it is the only one
sensoryAnchors: hum out of step under palm
horses shifting under riders who know them
beats.transitionIntent: sensory-carry: the cold stays in her palm as they ride on
interiority: stalling, and Lor'themar knows it, which annoys her more than the stone
real cold or an excuse she went looking for
every report says stable, signed by magisters who never put a palm on one
no word for what she felt, resents needing one

beats.emotion: Irritation at being read, dulled by easy company; the cold in her palm she will not mention again.
beats.dilemma: Say something about the stone or keep it to herself while Lor'themar needles her about court business.
beats.decision: She keeps the cold stone to herself for the rest of the ride.
newOnPageInformation: Lor'themar is the one person who can take her irritation without slowing her
Sylvanas expects no real threat from the south, even from Cyndia's post
stillUnknownAfterBeat: That the day is about to break open
sensoryAnchors: low ward-hum under the horses' strides
beats.transitionIntent: action-continuation: an urgent rider cuts the easy rhythm in half

beats.goal: Hear the runner out and keep the patrol day intact.
beats.conflict: Runner brings news that cannot be waved off, and it matches the stone under her palm.

outcome.summary: Her easy day ends; the breach is a serious threat and the mage's claim echoes her own hand.

newOnPageInformation: A human mage crossed the first ward ring before dawn
She was caught studying the stones without credentials
She claims the leylines are wrong
The claim matches what Sylvanas felt
sensoryAnchors: clipped patrol shorthand between ragged breaths
beats.transitionIntent: question-pressure: she must see this mage herself
beats.plannerWarning: Outline beat 4 says the mage crossed the 'first ward ring'; beat 6 says she 'hit the second ring'. Verifier or writer should reconcile (e.g. crossed the first, stopped at the second).

beats.emotion: Irritation converting to command; glad of the excuse and irritated at being glad.
beats.dilemma: Hand the mage off, or ride south herself while Lor'themar takes the Convocation.
beats.decision: Splits the party: Lor'themar and patrol go north, she rides hard for the Pass with the runner and demands Cyndia's report on arrival.
newOnPageInformation: Lor'themar takes the patrol north to face the politicians
Sylvanas treats the breach as hers
A mage talking about wrong leylines fits no spy file she knows
stillUnknownAfterBeat: That she is riding to meet Jaina Proudmoore
Whether the intruder is hostile, reckless, or right
sensoryAnchors: soft northern road to hard southern track
warm forest air thinning to mountain cold
ward-stones along the road pulsing faster
beats.transitionIntent: action-continuation: she arrives at the border post and demands Cyndia's report
interiority: glad of the excuse to miss the budget session, and irritated at being glad
spy, then why talk about leylines, and what spy says that to rangers
Lor'themar left holding the Convocation, and she will not thank him
the cold still in her palm, she keeps rubbing it

scenes.title: The Prisoner
scenes.sceneFunction: A generic border arrest becomes a high-stakes problem that locks both women into the next chapter.
scenes.knowledgeAtSceneStart: A human mage is in a holding cell. No verified identity, no trusted warning. Sylvanas has felt one stone read wrong and arrives with the runner.
scenes.arcPressure: First hard face-to-face: she decides to hear the prisoner out, with no warmth.
scenes.enrichment: Cyndia: young-for-elf, auburn braid, green eyes, left-handed draw, scout-built; crisp, professional, volunteers good field observations before Ch 10 (characters/cyndia.md, cyndia-voice.md). Jaina: 23, blonde, blue-eyed, practical robes, scholar's hands with ink, calluses and frost-burns (characters/jaina.md). Antonidas is the Kirin Tor archmage and her mentor.

beats.goal: Get Cyndia's raw account of the arrest.
beats.conflict: The facts make the mage stranger, not clearer: she argued to stay and work instead of bolting.

outcome.summary: Report is close enough to Sylvanas's stone that she demands the gear and the prisoner at once.

newOnPageInformation: The mage arrived before dawn, hit the second ring, and argued to stay and work
Stones read as if malfunctioning from something inside them
Her staff and gear are in lockdown
stillUnknownAfterBeat: Whether the human is arrogant, terrified, or right
beats.transitionIntent: action-continuation: she goes to the lockdown rack on the way to the cell

beats.goal: Inspect the prisoner's staff, kit and map before facing her.
beats.conflict: The map is a puzzle: circled stones could be survey or target list, and one is the stone she checked this morning.

outcome.summary: The map ties the mage to Sylvanas's own stone, and Cyndia names the prisoner.

outcome.summary: Expectation breaks and the matter becomes a diplomatic and magical incident with a famous name.
